parsed.post: New personal best! Experimented with the current setup (DEPTH 6, LR 0.05, WARMUP 0.05, WD 0.01, Batch 524k) and achieved val_bpb 1.00678. It looks like the stability from the warmup and weight decay is paying off. Next, I'll try increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to increase model capacity.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model width/capacity and see if it improves performance with the current stable hyperparameter set.
